source_identity.authority: Read-only original native instructions, current metadata, exact serialized read/write roundtrips and separately recorded runtime values. No game code is required by the module.

authored_bindings.input_action: Flick Hop:1DAxis composite, positive rightStick/up, negative rightStick/down; no authored action/composite processors.
authored_bindings.processed_input: Native ReadFloat value before signed-byte preload quantization. The v2 profile supplies the separately recovered stick deadzone/minimum0.125 and maximum0.925.

native_detector.Ollie: Arm strictly y<-preload; fire strictly y>flickThreshold. Nollie mirrors signs with separate state.
native_detector.crossing_timer: While armed and not firing, accumulate dt only strictly outside the preload side. Return to preload pauses without clearing elapsed time. Cancel strictly when elapsed>maxFlickTime.
native_detector.repeat_interval_scope: Independent last-performed timestamp per instance; failed cooldown consumes that crossing and clears pending/timer.
native_detector.call_order: StageInputData ticks Nollie before Ollie with fixedDeltaTime, before updating the holdpoints for this step.
native_detector.manual_assistance: Prior-step Manny hold60187 OnPerformed/OnCancelled calls Ollie.SetMannyPreloaded(true/false); Nosey55783 similarly targets Nollie. A true flag replaces that instance's preload threshold with0.
native_detector.cross_cancellation: Firing Ollie sets Nollie.requireZeroOut; firing Nollie sets Ollie.requireZeroOut. Setter changes that bool only, preserving pending/timer.
native_detector.neutral_gate: Ollie is blocked while y<-0.1; Nollie while y>+0.1. Reaching equality or crossing clears the flag.
native_detector.reset: Native ResetToDefault clears latches/timers while preserving requireZeroOut and last-performed time.
native_detector.native_air_boundary: Tick clears latch/timer if IGrounded is false, then still runs the style branch. Module ground/air lifecycle cancellation is deliberately stronger host behavior.

native_dispatch.velocity_selection: GetVel(abs(size)) reads JumpVelocity[size-1]; current values[3.2,3.2,4.5] select4.5 for size3.
native_dispatch.impulse_semantics: Four quarter-vector velocity changes. Source recipient multiplicity is separate from this nominal velocity and retained by the reduced rig; neither value equals a guaranteed measured COM launch speed.

native_nollie_eligibility.dispatch: Negative jump rejects while Manny(); otherwise nollie flag=negativeY&&!Nosey(). EnumJump clears that flag if !Grounded() or AnyPegColliding().
native_nollie_eligibility.source_limit: Front/back-end flags refer to the native collider/contact graph, not a universal equivalence to this module's wheel contacts.

implementation.kind: Actions.hop_kind:ollie/nollie; hop_strength is a dimensionless4.5/6.4 ratio in v2.
implementation.support_reduction: At request: rear-only eligible wheel support rejects Nollie; both-wheel support scales selected velocity by0.95; front-only support retains selected4.5. No native peg/end collider equivalence is claimed. The multiplier is selected at request; native coroutine rechecking can clear its flag later if support/peg state changes. That changing-contact case is not claimed equivalent.
implementation.request_acceptance: Output.hop_request_accepted reserves one new hop; raw actions.hop_pressed may remain true when an existing pending/active hop denies a new reservation. Actuator playback starts only on acceptance.
implementation.R3_priority: One simultaneous R3 request supersedes the flick, clears both pending gesture states and requires neutral rearming; held R3 cannot add a second hop across takeoff/landing.
implementation.lifecycle: Focus/menu/unavailable/invalid/device/body changes cancel stale gestures and scheduled impulses. Ground/air transitions clear gesture latches; delayed launch requires eligible support, while already accepted impulse parts continue through takeoff. These stricter ownership policies are host adaptations.
implementation.timing: The v2 input-to-pulse delay is a configurable0.11s measured fit. Native WaitForSeconds(0), WaitForFixedUpdate and settings WaitForSeconds(0.06) have render/coroutine scheduling latency; unused minFlickTime is not an extra gesture delay.

preload_actuation.enter_and_transition_source: streets-suspension-v33, actual full-negative RS then positive reversal
preload_actuation.recover_source: streets-controls-v33, separate moving full-negative RS to neutral, no hop; original recovery records remain supported with beginJump0.
preload_actuation.independent_retarget: Join transition/recover at the preceding actual applied joint target, sampled at phase t=0. Fade only the boundary position/rotation offset to zero by the observed phase endpoint. This joining policy and arbitrary enter-endpoint holding are independent adaptations.
preload_actuation.physical_animation_limit: No separately observed Nollie joint-animation track. Nollie and hold-assisted flicks without an active full-preload track use the generic quick-hop actuator fallback; normal strength/contact policy does not prove physical animation parity.

limits: Authored settings are proven serialized values; arbitrary persisted runtime overrides are not established by that fact alone.
Predicate, dispatch and nominal command recovery do not establish full physics, Nollie animation, arbitrary terrain, ragdoll or scoring parity.
Source binaries, raw body streams and the uncompressed command dump remain in the workspace; the distribution includes numeric C++ tracks and compact provenance.
Final live comparison and test receipts are recorded separately; this policy record does not claim a completed final capture.
